avoid_supplements.name: Red Yeast Rice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains naturally occurring lovastatin; additive statin effect increases myopathy and rhabdomyolysis risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient to discontinue red yeast rice before rosuvastatin initiation

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Niacin (>1000 mg/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates statin myopathy risk through unknown synergistic mechanisms
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose niacin; if combined therapy necessary, use doses <1000 mg/day with close monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Statins deplete CoQ10; supplementation may mitigate myalgia and muscle weakness symptoms
caution_supplements.action: Consider 100-200 mg daily if patient reports myalgia; monitor for symptom improvement

caution_supplements.name: Garlic extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce rosuvastatin levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor lipid panel if using high-dose garlic supplements; adjust rosuvastatin dose if needed

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and OATP1B1 inhibition increases rosuvastatin bioavailability and myopathy risk
avoid_foods.action: Advise complete avoidance of grapefruit and grapefruit juice during rosuvastatin therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay rosuvastatin absorption; minimal clinical impact on efficacy
caution_foods.action: Take rosuvastatin consistently with or without food; maintain consistent timing for optimal effect

monitoring_notes: Monitor CK levels and patient-reported muscle pain/weakness, especially if combining with other myopathy-risk agents or high-dose niacin. Assess renal function (eGFR) periodically as rosuvastatin is renally cleared and dose-dependent myopathy risk increases with impairment.
